caption: J.M. v. Summit City Board of Education
citation_line: J.M. v. Summit City Board of Education, No. 20-3391 (3d Cir. July 1, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge McNulty upheld an administrative determination that a school district had not violated its child-find obligations or denied a free appropriate public education before a first-grade student was diagnosed with autism.
qualification_rationale: The precedential appeal gives detailed guidance on when observable behavioral and academic difficulties trigger a school district’s duty to evaluate a child under the IDEA and Section 504, a recurring issue in special-education litigation.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, sustaining the district court’s legal and factual conclusions and its treatment of the administrative record.
